free_tier_limits: Up to 100 devices (cellular or Wi-Fi), 100,000 Data Operations per month pooled across all devices, and up to 100 MB of pooled cellular data per month.
rate_limits: 10,000 requests per 5 minutes per source IP for all API routes; selected token, account, and event routes: 100 per 5 minutes; SSE: 100 simultaneous connections per source IP; serial-number lookup: 50 per hour per access-token user account.
